## About
Westside Auto Parts is a parts store on West Flagler Street in Miami. We carry the everyday parts that keep a car running, like oil filters, timing belts, wipers, fuel pumps and NGK plugs, plus LED lights and accessories for inside the car.
Our customers tell us what matters to them: getting the right part at a fair price, with someone who can answer questions about fit and specs. One customer has been coming to us since she was a teenager, and another says the whole family and their friends shop here too. We are rated 4.8 from 90 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car parts: Oil filters, timing belts, wipers, fuel pumps, radiators, disc brake parts and NGK plugs.
- Brake lights: Emergency brake lights, including red ones.
- Interior car mats: Excalibur interior car mats for your car.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get a quote before I come in?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we'll give you a free quote.

Q: What if you don't have my part in stock?
A: We can order it. One customer said that when a part wasn't in stock, it typically came in within a few hours, or a day or less.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes, on Sunday we're open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
